t as ( select pt.created_at, pt.pnl, m.event_ticker, m.close_time::date as sdate, split_part(substring(m.event_ticker from position('-' in m.event_ticker)+1),'-',1) as token, exists(select 1 from ip group by sdate union all select 'b_game1', sdate, sum(pnl) from r where not (kind='game' and rn>1) group by sdate union all select 'c_all1', sdate, sum(pnl) from r where rn<=1 group by sdate ) select rule, count(*) as days, round(sum(p)::numeric,2) as total, round(min(p)::numeric,2) as worst_day, round((percentile_cont(0.05) within group (order by p))::numeric,2) as p5_day, round((percentile_cont(0.10) within group (order by p))::numeric,2) as p10_day, round(stddev(p)::numeric,3) as sd_day, count(*) filter (where p < 0) as losing_days from d group by rule order by rule
